description: This file defines the InterviewAttachmentAPI class, which provides CRUD API endpoints for managing interview attachments within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting interview attachments, and integrates with the system's data models and validation rules.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for interview attachments in recruitment module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all interview attachments for a given interview, with sorting and pagination support.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and adds a new interview attachment to a specified interview.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific interview attachment by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing interview attachment, possibly replacing the file content.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple interview attachments based on provided IDs.
